text:
customer_jane: Hey team — we're seeing a lot of 500s from the embeddings endpoint this morning and super high latency for EU customers. Requests from eu-west users are hitting us-west and getting cold-start delays. Example error from our app: "Embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 768". Can you help?

alice: sorry you're hitting that, can you paste a raw request/response (no PII) and a trace-id? Also which model are you calling?

customer_jane: trace-id: trace_0a9f3e. We're calling model: open-embed-1536-v2. Our client sets region=eu-west-1 in the header and we expect eu placement. Sample request header: `X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1`.

bjorn: quick sanity — dimension mismatch usually means we routed to a different model variant (older 768-dim model). If traffic spilled to another region we might hit a model alias that maps to a smaller embedder.

carmen: I see routing logs for that trace-id — forwarded from router-instance-7 in eu-west -> router-proxy-usw2-3 (spillover). Reason: eu-west pool at 100% and spill_policy=spill_to_other_regions.

dev-ryan: what batch size are you sending? Large batches + mixed model variants can cause unexpected shape errors if the runtime tries to collate responses.

customer_jane: batch_size=64. We assumed batching on client would help throughput.

alice: ok, two problems: 1) routing/spillover caused requests to go to a model with 768 dims, so mismatch. 2) cold-start when hitting us-west added >700ms on p95, plus our larger batch made it worse.

bjorn: repro steps for infra:
```
# find the request in router logs
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=emb-router -c router --since=2h | grep trace_0a9f3e -n
# check routing decision
grep "trace_0a9f3e" /var/log/redwood/router/decision.log | tail -n 50
# view pool saturation
rictl capacity get --pool eu-west-embeddings --window=5m
```

carmen: confirmed: pool eu-west-embeddings hit 100% at 08:12UTC and autoscale didn't spin up due to pending node quotas. Spill policy triggered at 08:12:11 and routed ~120 req/s to us-west for a minute.

dev-ryan: recommended immediate mitigations for the customer: 1) pin region via explicit param `region=eu-west-1` and add `fail_on_spill=true` to get 429 instead of a cross-region route, 2) reduce batch_size to 8-16 to avoid large.collate shape mismatches, 3) set expected_dim=1536 client-side so we surface mismatch earlier.

alice: temporary fix applied: support toggled fail_on_spill for this customer (account id acct_42) at 08:25UTC. We also instructed customer to drop batch size and resubmit.

customer_jane: after we dropped batch to 16 latency improved but still saw some requests hitting us-west for ~30s. We got one 429 after fail_on_spill toggle, which is preferable to silent fallback.

bjorn: long-term follow-ups for eng-infra: 1) increase autoscale headroom for eu-west-embeddings (quota/sa key), 2) add an explicit model alias guard so only compatible model dims are eligible for routing fallback, 3) expose a customer-visible metric `spillovers_total` per region and per account.

carmen: logging snippet from router decision.log: 
```
2026-03-14T08:12:11Z trace=trace_0a9f3e account=acct_42 region=eu-west-1 pool_eu=100% decision=spill -> target=us-west-2 reason="pool saturation" model_alias=open-embed-latest
2026-03-14T08:12:11Z trace=trace_0a9f3e routed_to=emb-instance-usw2-5 model_loaded=open-embed-768-v1
```

dev-ryan: that shows the exact root cause. open-embed-latest alias resolved differently in us-west (old v1). We must ensure alias resolution is region-aware.

alice: next steps: I created an internal ticket INC-2026-453 and attached logs. Assigning to eng-infra (carmen) and runtime (dev-ryan). Customer notified and provided a short repro doc.

customer_jane: thanks. Can you also confirm there won't be billing surprises from the cross-region requests? Some of our customers bill per-region.

carmen: billing note: cross-region spillover is billed to the account's primary region usage bucket by default. I'll loop in finance if a refund is needed. For now we can flag the minutes during 08:12–08:26 UTC.

alice: final checklist we shared with customer:
- client: set `region=eu-west-1` + `fail_on_spill=true`
- client: reduce batch_size to 8-16
- support: monitoring alert for `spillovers_total > 0` per account (we'll create)
- infra: increase eu-west headroom, fix alias resolution

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: autoscale-policy-update eu-west-embeddings (env=prod) by carmen at 2026-03-14T09:05:12Z :white_check_mark:

bjorn: closing loop: we patched alias resolution to be region-scoped and increased autoscale headroom. Will monitor for 24h.

customer_jane: great — latency is back to normal this morning, no more d-mismatch errors. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

alice: marking thread resolved, reopening if anything else pops up.
